scope: R42-R46 scalar-time fixed-charge source-initialized CFM family; not all possible sim2real methods
reason: Longer fitting and finer registered integration improve selected shape/PSD distances, while the joint source/noise/boundary/REAL criteria still fail.
goal_scope_clarification: The earlier optional conditional-response-versus-overall-spectrum question remains unanswered; no answer or approval is inferred.
candidate_future_question: Whether a separately identified source-conditioned charge/PSD response and noise-replacement model can be defined and validated with the available evidence.
future_direction_status: Unregistered hypothesis, not a selected model or an authorized relaxation of A-F.
needed_before_future_execution: Define the intended source/REAL population relationship and whether statistical charge calibration is part of the intended detector-response target.
Identify evidence separating charge-response effects from source energy/mix differences; unpaired marginal matching alone does not identify that separation.
Register one fixed method with a matched compute/data control and unchanged or explicitly prospectively revised acceptance scope.
limits: Current charge-population difference is not a proof that every fixed evaluator must fail its finite-sample threshold.
Current failures do not establish physical particle misclassification, loss of physical peaks, or impossibility of all waveform transports.
A mathematical invariant of ideal common invertible maps is not assumed for this stochastic preprocessing/ADC pipeline.
